result.topic_en: Determination of the complex inverse cosine f + ig = arccos(p + iq) via auxiliary angles A, B and a helping angle h, with a worked numerical example using logarithms.
result.transcription:
Bestimmung von $f + ig = \mathrm{Arc\,cos}\,(p+iq)$

Es sei

$1+p = a\cos A \qquad 1-p = b\cos B$
$q = a\sin A \qquad q = b\sin B$

$\frac{a-b}{2} = \cos f \qquad \sqrt{ab}.\cos\frac{1}{2}(A+B) = \sin f$
$\frac{a+b}{2} = \cos ig \qquad i\sqrt{ab}.\sin\frac{1}{2}(A+B) = \sin ig$

Hülfswinkel $= h$
$\cos ig = \frac{1}{\cos h}$
$\sin ig = i\tang h$
$\mathrm{tg}\, ig = i\sin h$

$\sqrt{\frac{a}{2}}(\cos\frac{1}{2}A + i\sin\frac{1}{2}A) = \cos\frac{1}{2}(f-ig)$
$\sqrt{\frac{a}{2}}(\cos\frac{1}{2}A - i\sin\frac{1}{2}A) = \cos\frac{1}{2}(f+ig)$
$\sqrt{\frac{b}{2}}(\cos\frac{1}{2}B - i\sin\frac{1}{2}B) = \sin\frac{1}{2}(f-ig)$
$\sqrt{\frac{b}{2}}(\cos\frac{1}{2}B + i\sin\frac{1}{2}B) = \sin\frac{1}{2}(f+ig)$

$g = \log\,\mathrm{hyp.}\,\tang(45^\circ + \frac{1}{2}h)$

$g$ in Secunden $= \frac{206265''}{0,43429}\cdot\log\,\mathrm{brigg}\,\mathrm{tag}(45^\circ+\frac{1}{2}h)$
